## Methodology & Caveats

- **Look-ahead bias mitigation**: prompt-based only. The system prompt anchors the LLM to the as-of date and forbids invoking post-date knowledge. This is imperfect — the model has training knowledge through May 2025. IC > 0.30 should be treated as evidence of leakage, not skill.
- **Sentiment**: held neutral (0.5) for Phase 1. Live agent uses Morgans VADER+FinBERT. When historical Morgans archives are available, this rerun will quantify sentiment's contribution.
- **No execution sim**: this report measures signal quality only. Phase 2 will layer rules, fractional Kelly sizing, and simulated fills against historical bars to produce an equity curve.
- **No regime split**: results are aggregated across the full window. A bull-market backtest can mask a flat-market signal.
